validation_policy: Fixed real A4C masked pairs from official fold 1; select minimum weighted mask objective. Test fold 0 never selects checkpoints.
checkpoint_policy: One atomic best.pt per training experiment; trainable adapters and point head only; no optimizer state.
coordinates: Input-image pixel xy coordinates; feature patch centers at patch_size/2 + k*patch_size; boundary distances and Huber residuals use input pixels.
assumptions: LoRA alpha=rank; LoRA on combined QKV, attention projection, fc1 and fc2 in every transformer block.
Frozen initialization backbone generates teacher matches.
K-means uses up to 4096 uniformly sampled foreground pixels and 10 Lloyd iterations; FPS selects 12 queries per cluster, repeating only in undersized nonempty clusters.
Two normalized 3x3 convolutions with 16 hidden channels and ReLU follow the cited DINO-Tracker head; local radius 35 input pixels, softmax temperature 1.
The top three teacher matches supervise their own queries; the estimated similarity transform supervises the remaining nine, following Eqs. 4-6. Degenerate groups do not contribute to LSC.
RandomAffine magnitudes and ColorJitter strength are reproduction defaults, not published M2P hyperparameters.
Uniform A4C sequence sampling, then two distinct timestamp-aligned annotated frames; no reference point identities enter training.
Physical square Cartesian grid from sector geometry only; myocardium from five-layer contour cells, clipped to the acquisition sector.
20,000 updates is an EchoXFlow adaptation budget, not the paper natural-video pretraining schedule.
Test trajectories are software-tracked middle-wall references; report physical EPE and localization PCK, not OA/AJ.
